join :: Maybe (Maybe b) ⟶ Maybe b — the Maybe-specific part
Just (Just b) →  Just b
Just Nothing  →  Nothing
Nothing       →  Nothing   (failure at either level propagates)

ports.tooltip: Maybe a — Just a (has a value) or Nothing (absent). If Nothing, f is never called.
f : a ⟶ Maybe b — user code; may itself return Nothing
Maybe b — Just b (every step succeeded) or Nothing (first failure propagated); never Maybe (Maybe b)
